items.title: Apple and Meta fined millions for breaching EU law
items.raw_content: BRUSSELS (Reuters) -Apple was fined 500 million euros ($570 million) on Wednesday and Meta 200 million euros, as European Union antitrust regulators handed out the first sanctions under landmark legislation aimed at curbing the power of Big Tech. The EU fines could stoke tensions with U.S. President Donald Trump who has threatened to levy tariffs against countries that penalise U.S. companies. Trump's White House called the fines a "novel form of economic extortion" that the United States will not tolerate.
items.title_zh: 苹果与 Meta 因违反欧盟法律被罚数百万欧元
items.summary: EU antitrust regulators fined Apple 500 million euros and Meta 200 million euros in the first sanctions under landmark legislation aimed at curbing Big Tech's power, prompting the White House to call the penalties a form of economic extortion.

items.title: Beijing hosts world’s first half-marathon for humanoid robots, Tiangong Ultra wins in two hours 40 minutes
items.raw_content: On Saturday, the world’s first half-marathon for humanoid robots took place in Beijing. The event, blending technology and sports, attracted 20 participating teams from Chinese universities, enterprises, and research institutions, with some 12,000 human runners taking part in the race alongside the robots.

items.title: Steering the CensorShip: Uncovering Representation Vectors for LLM "Thought" Control
items.title_zh: 操纵审查之船：揭示 LLM“思维”控制的表征向量
items.summary: Researchers use representation engineering on open-weight safety-tuned models to find a refusal-compliance vector, and in DeepSeek-R1-distilled reasoning models they identify a separate 'thought suppression' direction that can be steered to reduce censorship.

items.title: DiCE-Extended: A Robust Approach to Counterfactual Explanations in Machine Learning
items.title_zh: DiCE-Extended：更稳健的反事实解释框架
items.summary: DiCE-Extended extends the DiCE counterfactual explanation framework with multi-objective optimization and a new robustness metric, reporting better validity and stability across benchmark datasets such as COMPAS, Lending Club, German Credit and Adult Income.

items.title: MERA: Multimodal and Multiscale Self-Explanatory Model with Considerably Reduced Annotation for Lung Nodule Diagnosis
items.title_zh: MERA：面向肺结节诊断的多模态多尺度自解释模型
items.summary: MERA is a multimodal, multiscale model for lung nodule diagnosis that combines self-supervised learning, a Vision Transformer and semi-supervised active learning to work with sparse annotations; the authors report it matches or exceeds fully annotated state-of-the-art methods using only 1% labeled samples on the LIDC dataset.

items.title: Bigram Subnetworks: Mapping to Next Tokens in Transformer Language Models
items.title_zh: Bigram 子网络：Transformer 语言模型中的下一词元映射
items.summary: The authors identify bigram subnetworks in transformer language models up to 1B parameters that make next-token predictions from the current token alone and are critical to performance despite accounting for less than 0.2% of model parameters.

items.title: Naturally Computed Scale Invariance in the Residual Stream of ResNet18
items.title_zh: ResNet18 残差流中自然计算的尺度不变性
items.summary: This study examines how ResNet18 builds invariance to scale, focusing on its residual stream, a component that the previously studied InceptionV1 lacks. The author finds scale-invariant channels in intermediate blocks produced by summing scale-equivariant residual representations, and uses ablation experiments to probe a causal link to recognition behavior.

items.title: Optimism, Expectation, or Sarcasm? Multi-Class Hope Speech Detection in Spanish and English
items.title_zh: 乐观、期待还是讽刺？西班牙语与英语的多类别希望表达检测
items.summary: The study introduces PolyHope V2, a dataset of more than 30,000 annotated English and Spanish tweets that separates generalized, realistic, unrealistic and sarcastic hope, and finds fine-tuned transformers outperform prompt-based LLMs on the nuanced categories.

items.title: Calibrating Translation Decoding with Quality Estimation on LLMs
items.title_zh: 用质量评估校准 LLM 的翻译解码
items.summary: The paper calibrates translation hypothesis likelihoods against quality by optimizing their Pearson correlation, reporting gains after training on 2K instances per direction and releasing a 10-language model with code and human evaluation data.

items.title: SAGA: A Security Architecture for Governing AI Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: SAGA：面向 AI 智能体系统的安全治理架构
items.summary: SAGA is a security architecture that gives users oversight of AI agents' lifecycle by registering them with a central Provider that stores access-control policies, and it uses cryptographically derived tokens to constrain inter-agent communication, with the authors reporting minimal performance overhead in their evaluations.
